title: Moroccan Harira Soup
description: A rich and flavorful vegetarian Moroccan soup made with luxurious ingredients and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat the luxurious olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the lamb broth, harira, cumin, paprika, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the torn pita bread to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve with a side of crusty bread or a green salad, if desired.
